name: io.github.yanlinglabs/video-extract-mcp
description: Extract any video from a URL: transcript plus the keyframes that matter, all locally.

environmentVariables.name: VIDEO_EXTRACT_COOKIES_FROM_BROWSER
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'auto' to borrow browser cookies only when a platform refuses a download (age-restricted, members-only, or bot-checked media).

environmentVariables.name: VIDEO_EXTRACT_MODELS_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where local speech models live. Defaults to ~/.cache/video-extract-mcp/models; they are fetched on demand.

environmentVariables.name: VIDEO_EXTRACT_MAX_CONCURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: How many analyses may run at once. Default 4; each costs about 1.1 GB peak.
